paper_title: Search for invisible axion dark matter with a multiple-cell haloscope
notes: Multiple-cell (double-cell) cavity haloscope CAPP-9T. Excludes g_agamma >= 11.1 x g_KSVZ over 13.0-13.9 ueV at 90% CL.
